value.drug_or_class: Live Attenuated Viral Vaccines (Measles, Mumps, Rubella, Varicella)
value.effect: Passively acquired antiviral antibodies neutralize vaccine viruses, inhibiting protective immune response development for up to 3 to 11 months.
value.management: Defer live virus immunization for at least 3 months following IVIg infusion; revaccinate if administered within 14 days prior to IVIg.

refs.quote: The passive transfer of antibodies with immunoglobulin administration may interfere with the response to live virus vaccines such as measles, mumps, rubella, and varicella

value.drug_or_class: Serological Diagnostic Assays (Coombs Test, Hepatitis, Syphilis Serology)
value.effect: Passive transfer of donor antibodies causes transient positive serologic testing (e.g., direct antiglobulin / Coombs test), mimicking active infection or hemolysis.
value.management: Interpret serological test results with caution and account for recent IVIg administration when evaluating hemolytic or infectious markers.
